<h1 id="10--资源加密把-dll-藏进保险箱">10 · 资源加密：把 DLL 藏进保险箱</h1>
<h2 id="目录">目录</h2>

<li><a href="#2-spn-%E4%B8%89%E9%98%B6%E6%AE%B5%E5%8A%A0%E5%AF%86%E7%AE%97%E6%B3%95" rel="noopener nofollow">SPN 三阶段加密算法</a></li>
<li><a href="#3-xorshift128-prng2%5E128-1-%E5%91%A8%E6%9C%9F%E7%9A%84%E9%AB%98%E5%BC%BA%E5%BA%A6%E9%9A%8F%E6%9C%BA%E5%BA%8F%E5%88%97" rel="noopener nofollow">xorshift128 PRNG：2^128-1 周期的高强度随机序列</a></li>
<li><a href="#4-%E5%8A%A0%E5%AF%86%E6%B5%81%E7%A8%8B%E5%AE%8C%E6%95%B4%E5%AE%9E%E7%8E%B0" rel="noopener nofollow">加密流程完整实现</a></li>

<hr>
<h2 id="1-为什么需要加密资源">1. 为什么需要加密资源</h2>
<p>许多 .NET 程序将 DLL 作为 Embedded Resource。即使主程序被保护，攻击者解包后可以直接反编译这些裸 DLL。</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="2-spn-三阶段加密算法">2. SPN 三阶段加密算法</h2>
<p>SPN（Substitution-Permutation Network）是 AES 的核心思想。我们实现三阶段：</p>
<h3 id="阶段-1sbox-代换">阶段 1：SBox 代换</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// 生成 256 字节随机 SBox
static byte[] GenerateSBox(uint seed)
{
    var rng = new XorShift128(seed);
    var sbox = new byte[256];
    for (int i = 0; i &lt; 256; i++) sbox[i] = (byte)i;

    // Fisher-Yates 洗牌
    for (int i = 255; i &gt; 0; i--)
    {
        int j = (int)(rng.Next() % (i + 1));
        (sbox[i], sbox[j]) = (sbox[j], sbox[i]);
    }
    return sbox;
}

// 代换
for (int i = 0; i &lt; data.Length; i++)
    data[i] = sbox[data[i]];
</code></pre>
<h3 id="阶段-2arx-流密钥addition-rotation-xor">阶段 2：ARX 流密钥（Addition-Rotation-XOR）</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// 使用 xorshift128 PRNG 生成流密钥
var rng = new XorShift128(seed);
for (int i = 0; i &lt; data.Length; i++)
{
    byte k = rng.NextByte();
    data[i] = (byte)(data[i] + k);                  // 加法混合
    data[i] = (byte)((data[i] &lt;&lt; 3) | (data[i] &gt;&gt; 5)); // 循环左旋 3
    data[i] ^= rng.NextByte();                      // XOR 混合
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="阶段-3字节置换">阶段 3：字节置换</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// Fisher-Yates 洗牌打乱位置
var rng2 = new XorShift128(permSeed);
for (int i = data.Length - 1; i &gt; 0; i--)
{
    int j = (int)(rng2.Next() % (i + 1));
    (data[i], data[j]) = (data[j], data[i]);
}
</code></pre>
<p>三阶段后的加密数据与原始内容无任何可识别模式。</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="3-xorshift128-prng2128-1-周期">3. xorshift128 PRNG：2^128-1 周期</h2>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">struct XorShift128
{
    uint p0, p1, p2, p3;

    public XorShift128(uint seed)
    {
        // 用简单的 LCG 从种子生成初始状态
        p0 = (uint)(seed * 214013 + 2531011);
        p1 = (uint)(p0 * 214013 + 2531011);
        p2 = (uint)(p1 * 214013 + 2531011);
        p3 = (uint)(p2 * 214013 + 2531011);
    }

    public uint Next()
    {
        uint t = p0 ^ (p0 &lt;&lt; 11);
        p0 = p1; p1 = p2; p2 = p3;
        p3 = p3 ^ (p3 &gt;&gt; 19) ^ (t ^ (t &gt;&gt; 8));
        return p3;
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>相比 ConfuserEx 的 xorshift32（周期 2^32-1），xorshift128 的状态空间提升了 2^96 倍，抗分析能力显著增强。</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="4-加密流程完整实现">4. 加密流程完整实现</h2>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">static byte[] Encrypt(byte[] data, out uint seed, out uint permSeed)
{
    var rngCrypto = System.Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator.Create();
    byte[] seedBytes = new byte[8];
    rngCrypto.GetBytes(seedBytes);
    seed = BitConverter.ToUInt32(seedBytes, 0);
    permSeed = BitConverter.ToUInt32(seedBytes, 4);

    var result = (byte[])data.Clone();

    // 1. SBox 代换
    var sbox = GenerateSBox(seed);
    for (int i = 0; i &lt; result.Length; i++)
        result[i] = sbox[result[i]];

    // 2. ARX 流密钥
    var rng = new XorShift128(seed);
    for (int i = 0; i &lt; result.Length; i++)
    {
        result[i] += rng.NextByte();
        result[i] = (byte)((result[i] &lt;&lt; 3) | (result[i] &gt;&gt; 5));
        result[i] ^= rng.NextByte();
    }

    // 3. 字节置换
    var rng2 = new XorShift128(permSeed);
    for (int i = result.Length - 1; i &gt; 0; i--)
    {
        int j = (int)(rng2.Next() % (i + 1));
        (result[i], result[j]) = (result[j], result[i]);
    }

    return result;
}
</code></pre>
<p>存储格式：<code>[0xC0 0xDE 0xFA 0xFE] + [seed 4B] + [origLen 4B] + [permSeed 4B] + [加密数据]</code></p>
<hr>
<h2 id="5-运行时解密--assemblyresolve">5. 运行时解密 + AssemblyResolve</h2>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">internal static class ResourceEncryptor
{
    static Dictionary&lt;string, byte[]&gt; _decryptedAssemblies = new();

    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // 1. 扫描所有资源找魔术头 0xC0 0xDE 0xFA 0xFE
        foreach (var resName in asm.GetManifestResourceNames())
        {
            if (buf[0] != 0xC0 || buf[1] != 0xDE ||
                buf[2] != 0xFA || buf[3] != 0xFE) continue;

            // 2. 读取 seed, origLen, permSeed
            uint seed = BitConverter.ToUInt32(buf, 4);
            uint origLen = BitConverter.ToUInt32(buf, 8);
            uint permSeed = BitConverter.ToUInt32(buf, 12);

            // 3. 解密（三阶段反向）
            byte[] decrypted = Decrypt(buf, 16, origLen, seed, permSeed);

            // 4. Assembly.Load 加载程序集
            var loaded = Assembly.Load(decrypted);
            _decryptedAssemblies[loaded.GetName().Name] = decrypted;
        }

        // 5. 挂接 AssemblyResolve 事件
        AppDomain.CurrentDomain.AssemblyResolve += (_, args) =&gt;
        {
            var name = new AssemblyName(args.Name).Name;
            return _decryptedAssemblies.TryGetValue(name, out var bytes)
                ? Assembly.Load(bytes) : null;
        };
    }

    // 解密：三阶段逆操作
    static byte[] Decrypt(byte[] enc, int offset, uint origLen, uint seed, uint permSeed)
    {
        var data = new byte[origLen];
        Array.Copy(enc, offset, data, 0, origLen);

        // 逆置换
        var rng2 = new XorShift128(permSeed);
        for (int i = (int)origLen - 1; i &gt; 0; i--)
        {
            int j = (int)(rng2.Next() % (i + 1));
            (data[i], data[j]) = (data[j], data[i]);
        }

        // 逆 ARX
        var rng = new XorShift128(seed);
        for (int i = 0; i &lt; origLen; i++)
        {
            data[i] ^= rng.NextByte();
            data[i] = (byte)((data[i] &gt;&gt; 3) | (data[i] &lt;&lt; 5));  // 循环右旋 3
            data[i] -= rng.NextByte();
        }

        // 逆 SBox
        var sbox = GenerateSBox(seed);
        var invSBox = new byte[256];
        for (int i = 0; i &lt; 256; i++) invSBox[sbox[i]] = (byte)i;
        for (int i = 0; i &lt; origLen; i++)
            data[i] = invSBox[data[i]];

        return data;
    }
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="6-性能与内存">6. 性能与内存</h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>指标</th>
<th>未加密</th>
<th>SPN 加密</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>程序集大小</td>
<td>+0</td>
<td>+0（等大小替换）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>启动时间</td>
<td>正常</td>
<td>+50-200ms</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>运行时</td>
<td>正常</td>
<td>无影响（解密仅一次）</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<hr>
<h2 id="7-结语">7. 结语</h2>
<p>SPN 三阶段加密提供了远强于纯 XOR 的加密强度。攻击者解包后看到的是完全随机的字节，无法判断哪个资源是 DLL。</p>
<p>下一篇将讲解<strong>类型注入机制</strong>——保护引擎如何实现零外部 DLL 依赖。</p>
